content:
# Crossplane XRD + Composition (Functions Mode)

## File Layout

```
├── xrd.yaml
├── composition.yaml
├── composition-parameters.yaml
├── xrc-dev.yaml
└── xrc-prod.yaml
```

---

## 1. XRD — CompositeResourceDefinition

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: applicationinfrastructures.app.example.com
spec:
  group: app.example.com
  names:
    kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
    listKind: ApplicationInfrastructureList
    plural: applicationinfrastructures
    singular: applicationinfrastructure
    shortNames:
      - appinfra
  scope: Namespaced
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      storage: true
      subresources:
        status: {}
      additionalPrinterColumns:
        - name: Environment
          type: string
          jsonPath: .spec.parameters.environment
        - name: Region
          type: string
          jsonPath: .spec.parameters.region
        - name: READY
          type: string
          jsonPath: .status.conditions[?(@.type=='Ready')].status
        - name: AGE
          type: date
          jsonPath: .metadata.creationTimestamp
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              required:
                - parameters
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - providerConfigRef
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: [dev, prod]
                      description: Target environment.
                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: AWS region to deploy into.
                    providerConfigRef:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        Name of the aws ProviderConfig (e.g. "aws-dev-us-east-1").
                    rdsInstanceType:
                      type: string
                      default: db.t3.micro
                      description: RDS instance class.
                    multiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                      description: Enable multi-AZ for RDS.
                    sseAlgorithm:
                      type: string
                      enum: [AES256, aws:kms]
                      default: AES256
                      description: S3 server-side encryption algorithm.
                    kmsKeyId:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        KMS key ARN. Required when sseAlgorithm is aws:kms.
                        Also used for RDS storage encryption in prod.
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        OIDC provider ARN for IAM trust policy.
                        Required in prod for workload identity.
                    oidcSubject:
                      type: string
                      description: OIDC subject claim (e.g. "system:serviceaccount:default:app").
                    replicationTargetRegion:
                      type: string
                      description: >-
                        Cross-region replication target. Set in prod.
                        Leave empty in dev.
                    backupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      default: 7
                      minimum: 7
                      description: RDS automated backup retention (days).
                # The actual resource state is derived by the Composition;
                # we expose key outputs for consumption.
                # (Crossplane v2: no need to declare resourceRefs in spec)
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                conditions:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                      status:
                        type: string
                      reason:
                        type: string
                      message:
                        type: string
                      lastTransitionTime:
                        type: string
                        format: date-time
```

---

## 2. Composition — Patch-and-Transform

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v2
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: applicationinfrastructure
  labels:
    example.com/managed-by: crossplane
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: app.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
  mode: Resources
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Composition Parameters (per-environment values injected by the XRC)
  # These are NOT the same as XRD spec.parameters — they are a separate
  # mechanism available in Composition v2 that lets you override values
  # at the composition level without changing the XRD schema.
  # We use BOTH: XRD parameters for user-facing config, composition
  # parameters for operator-level defaults/overrides.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  patchAndTransform:
    # Patch from the composite resource's spec.parameters into
    # a local "params" namespace for the resources to consume.
    patches:
      # --- Environment / Region ---
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
        toFieldPath: parameters.environment
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
        toFieldPath: parameters.region
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigRef
        toFieldPath: parameters.providerConfigRef
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      # --- RDS ---
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsInstanceType
        toFieldPath: parameters.rdsInstanceType
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.multiAZ
        toFieldPath: parameters.multiAZ
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.backupRetentionDays
        toFieldPath: parameters.backupRetentionDays
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      # --- Encryption ---
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.sseAlgorithm
        toFieldPath: parameters.sseAlgorithm
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.kmsKeyId
        toFieldPath: parameters.kmsKeyId
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      # --- IAM / OIDC ---
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
        toFieldPath: parameters.oidcProviderArn
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcSubject
        toFieldPath: parameters.oidcSubject
        type: FromCompositeParameter

      # --- S3 Replication ---
      - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.replicationTargetRegion
        toFieldPath: parameters.replicationTargetRegion
        type: FromCompositeParameter

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resources
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  resources:
    # ================================================================
    # 1. S3 BUCKET — versioned, encrypted, no public access
    # ================================================================
    - name: bucket
      base:
        apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Bucket
        spec:
          forProvider:
            bucket: app-assets
            acl: private
            tags:
              managed-by: crossplane
            # Versioning
            versioning:
              status: Enabled
            # Server-Side Encryption (default AES-256)
            websiteConfiguration: {}  # placeholder to satisfy schema
            # Block ALL public access
            publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
              blockPublicAcls: true
              blockPublicPolicy: true
              ignorePublicAcls: true
              restrictPublicBuckets: true
          providerConfigRef:
            name: ""  # patched below
          writeConnectionSecretToRef:
            name: app-assets-connection
            namespace: crossplane-system
      patches:
        # Inject provider config from parameters
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # Inject region
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # SSE: if KMS key provided, switch algorithm and set key
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.sseAlgorithm
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.rules[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault.sseAlgorithm
          type: FromCompositeParameter
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.kmsKeyId
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.rules[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault.kmsMasterKeyID
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # Tag with environment
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # Cross-region replication (prod only; dev leaves this empty
        # and the field simply isn't patched)
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.replicationTargetRegion
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.replicationConfiguration.rules[0].destination.region
          type: FromCompositeParameter

      # Read back bucket ARN for use by other resources
      readinessPolicy: type-reflect
      readyWhen:
        - fieldPath: status.atLatest
      defaults:
        - type: FromCompositeResourceClaim
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.crossplane.io/claim-name
        - type: FromCompositeResourceClaim
          fromFieldPath: metadata.namespace
          toFieldPath: metadata.labels.crossplane.io/claim-namespace
        - type: FromCompositeResourceClaim
          fromFieldPath: metadata.name
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations.self.crossplane.io/claim-name
        - type: FromCompositeResourceClaim
          fromFieldPath: metadata.namespace
          toFieldPath: metadata.annotations.self.crossplane.io/claim-namespace

    # ================================================================
    # 2. RDS POSTGRESQL INSTANCE — deletion protected, encrypted
    # ================================================================
    - name: rds-instance
      base:
        apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: DBInstance
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: ""  # patched
            allocatedStorage: 20
            dbName: appdb
            engine: postgres
            engineVersion: "15"
            instanceClass: db.t3.micro  # patched per env
            username: appuser
            # Security
            publiclyAccessible: false
            deletionProtection: true
            # Backup
            backupRetentionPeriod: 7
            # Multi-AZ (patched per env)
            multiAz: false
            # Storage encryption (prod)
            storageEncrypted: true
            # Network (VPC)
            vpcSecurityGroupIds:
              - sg-000000000  # placeholder — replace via external ref
            dbSubnetGroupName: app-db-subnets
            # Skip final snapshot on delete (Crossplane manages lifecycle)
            skipFinalSnapshot: false
            tags:
              managed-by: crossplane
          providerConfigRef:
            name: ""
          writeConnectionSecretToRef:
            name: rds-appdb-connection
            namespace: crossplane-system
          # Deletion policy: Protect to prevent accidental Terraform/Crossplane drift deletion
          deletionPolicy: Protect
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.rdsInstanceType
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.multiAZ
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.backupRetentionDays
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # KMS encryption for storage (prod)
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.kmsKeyId
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.kmsKeyId
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment
          type: FromCompositeParameter

      readinessPolicy: type-reflect
      readyWhen:
        - fieldPath: status.atLatest

    # ================================================================
    # 3. IAM ROLE — service account with least-privilege trust
    # ================================================================
    - name: iam-role
      base:
        apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Role
        spec:
          forProvider:
            region: ""  # patched
            assumeRolePolicy: |
              {
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [
                  {
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Principal": {
                      "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"
                    },
                    "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
                  }
                ]
              }
            inlinePolicies:
              - name: app-read-assets
                policy: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                      {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Action": [
                          "s3:GetObject",
                          "s3:ListBucket"
                        ],
                        "Resource": [
                          "arn:aws:s3:::app-assets",
                          "arn:aws:s3:::app-assets/*"
                        ]
                      }
                    ]
                  }
            path: /
            tags:
              managed-by: crossplane
          providerConfigRef:
            name: ""
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.providerConfigRef
          toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.region
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
          type: FromCompositeParameter

        # Override trust policy with OIDC when parameters are present
        # (prod scenario). If oidcProviderArn is empty (dev), the base
        # EC2 trust policy remains.
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.oidcProviderArn
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
          type: FromCompositeParameter
          transforms:
            - type: string
              string:
                fmt: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [
                      {
                        "Effect": "Allow",
                        "Principal": {
                          "Federated": "{{.}}"
                        },
                        "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
                        "Condition": {
                          "StringEquals": {
                            "{{.}}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:app"
                          }
                        }
                      }
                    ]
                  }

        - fromFieldPath: parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.tags.environment
          type: FromCompositeParameter

      readinessPolicy: type-reflect
      readyWhen:
        - fieldPath: status.atLatest

    # ================================================================
    # 4. SECRET — DB connection string (encrypted at rest)
    #
    # In production, this would be stored via provider-secret-store
    # (e.g. AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). Here we create a
    # Kubernetes Secret annotated for external encryption. The
    # connectionSecret from the RDS resource is linked via a
    # composition-level patch.
    #
    # For true external secret store integration, add:
    #   - apiVersion: secretstores.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
    #     kind: ExternalSecret
    #     (from provider-secret-store)
    # ================================================================
    - name: db-secret
      base:
        apiVersion: v1
        kind: Secret
        metadata:
          name: ""
          namespace: crossplane-system
          labels:
            crossplane.io/managed-by: applicationinfrastructure
        type: Opaque
        data:
          # Populated by the composition from the RDS connection secret
          # via a patch that reads the RDS writeConnectionSecretToRef.
          # In practice, the RDS provider writes its own connection secret;
          # this object serves as a named reference / rotation target.
          endpoint: ""
      patches:
        - fromFieldPath: parameters.environment
          toFieldPath: metadata.name
          type: FromCompositeParameter
          transforms:
            - type: string
              string:
                fmt: db-connection-{{.}}

      # The RDS provider already writes a connection secret to
      # rds-appdb-connection. We reference it rather than duplicate.
      # If using provider-secret-store, replace this resource with:
      #
      #   - name: db-external-secret
      #     base:
      #       apiVersion: secretstores.crossplane.io/v1alpha1
      #       kind: ExternalSecret
      #       spec:
      #         secretStoreConfigRef:
      #           name: vault-prod
      #         data:
      #           - name: DB_HOST
      #             remoteRef:
      #               key: crossplane/rds/appdb
              #               property: endpoint
      #
      readinessPolicy: type-reflect

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Mode: Resources (default in v2) — each entry above is a template.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
```

---

## 3. Composition Parameters (Optional Operator Override)

If you prefer to use `spec.parameters` on the **Composition** (v2) rather than (or in addition to) the XRD, here's the schema:

```yaml
# composition-parameters.yaml
# This file is NOT a standalone resource — it's included as
# `spec.patches` + `spec.resources` within the Composition above.
# Shown separately for clarity of the parameter contract.

# Parameters consumed by the Composition (populated from XRC spec.parameters):
parameters:
  environment:
    type: string
    description: "dev" or "prod"
  region:
    type: string
    description: AWS region
  providerConfigRef:
    type: string
    description: Name of the target aws ProviderConfig
  rdsInstanceType:
    type: string
    default: db.t3.micro
  multiAZ:
    type: boolean
    default: false
  backupRetentionDays:
    type: integer
    default: 7
  sseAlgorithm:
    type: string
    default: AES256
  kmsKeyId:
    type: string
    default: ""
  oidcProviderArn:
    type: string
    default: ""
  oidcSubject:
    type: string
    default: ""
  replicationTargetRegion:
    type: string
    default: ""
```

> **Note:** In Crossplane v2, composition-level parameters are declared via `spec.patches` using `type: FromCompositeParameter` (as shown in the Composition above). If you want a **separate** composition parameter surface (distinct from XRD spec), use `spec.parameters` on the Composition and reference them via `FromCompositionParameter` patch type. The example above uses the XRD `spec.parameters` directly for simplicity.

---

## 4. XRC Instances (Per-Environment)

### Dev

```yaml
# xrc-dev.yaml
apiVersion: app.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
metadata:
  name: app-infra-dev
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    providerConfigRef: aws-dev-us-east-1
    rdsInstanceType: db.t3.micro
    multiAZ: false
    sseAlgorithm: AES256
    backupRetentionDays: 7
    # No OIDC, no KMS, no replication in dev
```

### Prod

```yaml
# xrc-prod.yaml
apiVersion: app.example.com/v1alpha1
kind: ApplicationInfrastructure
metadata:
  name: app-infra-prod
  namespace: crossplane-system
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    providerConfigRef: aws-prod-us-east-1
    rdsInstanceType: db.t3.medium
    multiAZ: true
    sseAlgorithm: aws:kms
    kmsKeyId: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/1a2b3c4d-5678-90ab-cdef-1234567890ab
    backupRetentionDays: 14
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE
    oidcSubject: "system:serviceaccount:default:app"
    replicationTargetRegion: us-west-2
```

---

## 5. Supporting ProviderConfig (Reference)

```yaml
# providerconfig-dev.yaml
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev-us-east-1
spec:
  credentials:
    source: InjectedIdentity   # IRSA / Pod Identity
  region: us-east-1

---
# providerconfig-prod.yaml
apiVersion: aws.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-prod-us-east-1
spec:
  credentials:
    source: InjectedIdentity
  region: us-east-1
```

---

## Acceptance Criteria Mapping

| # | Criterion | Where Satisfied |
|---|-----------|----------------|
| 1 | Bucket: versioning, SSE, no public access | `bucket` resource: `versioning.status: Enabled`, `serverSideEncryptionConfiguration`, `publicAccessBlockConfiguration` (all four flags `true`) |
| 2 | RDS: deletion protection, backup ≥ 7d, not public | `rds-instance`: `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 7` (patched to 14 in prod), `publiclyAccessible: false`, `deletionPolicy: Protect` |
| 3 | Secret: never plaintext in Git | RDS `writeConnectionSecretToRef` writes to a k8s Secret in `crossplane-system` (encrypted at rest by cluster encryption or external KMS). The `db-secret` resource is a named reference. For external stores, swap in `provider-secret-store` `ExternalSecret`. |
| 4 | IAM: least privilege, no wildcard on prod | `iam-role` base policy scopes to `s3:GetObject`/`s3:ListBucket` on the specific bucket ARN. Prod overrides trust to OIDC (no `ec2.amazonaws.com` wildcard). |
| 5 | Cluster: (out of scope for this XRD — EKS handled by separate composition) | — |
| 6 | HTTPS: (out of scope for this XRD — ALB/CloudFront handled separately) | — |
| 7 | Environment isolation | Separate XRC instances (`app-infra-dev`, `app-infra-prod`) with distinct `providerConfigRef` and parameters. Changing prod XRC does not affect dev composite. |

---

## Key Design Decisions

1. **Functions mode (`patch-and-transform`)** — no CEL, no Go functions. All transforms are declarative patches, making the composition auditable and debuggable via `kubectl explain` and `crossplane get`.

2. **XRD `spec.parameters` as the environment knob** — a single composite resource type handles both dev and prod. The XRC is the only thing that differs per environment, satisfying "dev and prod are independently deployable."

3. **`deletionPolicy: Protect` on RDS** — even if the XRC is deleted, Crossplane will not delete the RDS instance without explicit intervention. Combined with `deletionProtection: true` (AWS-side), this gives a two-layer guard.

4. **Conditional OIDC trust via transform** — the `string.fmt` transform in the IAM role patch conditionally renders the OIDC trust policy. When `oidcProviderArn` is empty (dev), the patch produces an empty string and the base `ec2.amazonaws.com` trust remains.

5. **Secret strategy** — the RDS provider natively writes a `writeConnectionSecretToRef`. For external stores (Vault, AWS SM), replace the `db-secret` resource with an `ExternalSecret` from `provider-secret-store` as shown in the comment.
